evidence_kind: Executed 256 real Qwen2.5 1.5B CPU inferences on 32+96 disjoint original NLBSE issues

limitations: Official NLBSE test archive also used for disjoint exploratory development; not valid for official leaderboard.
Prompt candidate v2 was motivated by aggregate first-96 errors; first 96 excluded from this retest.
Class-balanced accuracy differs from source-population-weighted accuracy.
No repository IDs in published CSV, so cross-project leakage cannot be fully excluded.
Owner-assigned issue labels are noisy; no adjudication or client SLA evidence.
No actual deployed n8n/SQLite backend is involved in this stand-alone classification evaluation.
results.non_overlap: all test/development issue IDs unique; no IDs shared with first 96-case diagnostic
results.prompt_selection_rule: dev macro-F1 higher, ties original v1

selected_prompt_vs_baseline_accuracy_del.interpretation: diagnostic uncertainty under within-class resampling; not full-population or cross-project inference

v2_vs_v1_accuracy_delta.interpretation: diagnostic uncertainty under within-class resampling; not full-population or cross-project inference

interpretation.new_holdout_counts: Qwen v2 54/96, Qwen v1 52/96, frozen keyword 46/96
interpretation.primary_comparison: v2 macro-F1 0.54445 versus rules 0.46798 (new balanced 96-case sample)
interpretation.supported_hypotheses: v2 improvements in question recall and macro-F1 over v1 on same holdout, selected prompt macro-F1 > baseline
interpretation.caution: Accuracy delta v2 vs baseline 0.08333 has 95% paired stratified bootstrap interval [-0.02083, 0.1875], overlapping zero
interpretation.critical_limitation: question recall only 6/24; not safe as autonomous production router
interpretation.scope: NOT original NLBSE full 142320-case leaderboard, not production customer data/ROI
